params.body:
Newsletters arriving at the reading address on gentells.com are read by the pipeline (gentells-pipeline, same day). A sender nobody follows yet becomes a proposed source in the queue `Newsletters`. This puts those on the Sources page.

## What changes

- **Needs a look**: "N newsletters arrived from a sender not followed yet", folded like the cited publishers. Each shows the sender's address and when its last edition came, with Follow it (starts its trial) and Not for us (rejects it, and it is not read again). They are not mixed into the proposals or Approve all.
- **All sources**: a followed newsletter is listed in a group "newsletters, read as they arrive", not under "read by no adapter", since no adapter reads it.

## Tests

- `e2e/sources-newsletters.spec.js` (3 tests): the line and its row, Follow it, Not for us, the group.
- `npm run build` and `npx playwright test`: 99 of 99.
params.title: Sources: newsletters from new senders
